newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian 91-day T-bill rate falls to 11.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian 91-day T-bill rate falls to 11.0 pct.

text.p: Rates on 91-day Lithuanian treasury bills continued a downward trend at Monday's auction and the issue was oversubscribed, the central bank said.
The average accepted rate was 11.00 percent versus 11.08 percent at the last auction for 91-day paper on September 3.
The highest accepted rate was 11.90 percent and the lowest was 9.98 percent. The 55 million litas issue was oversubscribed with bids totalling 99 million litas.
The settlement date is September 12 and the bills mature on December 12.
